scientific_integrity: General spatiality and rank-two reconstruction have known antecedents; the stated new classification is the contrast between the two specific metric partial-isometry monoid automorphism groups. Computations are finite consistency checks, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: The all-parameter theorems are proved mathematically. Exhaustive finite normalizer checks cover cycle sizes 3–8 and wheel rim sizes 5–7 only; they do not establish historical uniqueness. The 2011 source on automorphisms of partial endomorphism semigroups was available only through its published abstract. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Affine-to-dihedral automorphism collapse for cyclic and wheel partial-isometry monoids
